notes: Planet Lab: adds the first official interactive 3D world prototype to Agent City. A new 3D Planet Lab entry opens a dependency-free WebGL viewer with drag-to-orbit, wheel zoom, Planet / Region / Local modes, clickable known locations, camera focus transitions, and a Local view driven by authoritative Simulation x/y coordinates for citizens, structures, routes, and visitor presence. Planet/Region mode is explicitly a presentation shell that magnifies the existing local tangent frame onto a globe without claiming global latitude/longitude or exposing hidden seeded-world truth. The prototype is read-only and does not grant visitor control over citizens or modify Simulation state.
